Subject: KV priming + fallback validation notes

Marissa / team,

I ran a lab on KV priming last week and documented the commands + expected durations in the runbook PDF (section 3.2). Notes: priming for 1M tokens for the target model takes ~22m on our dedicated pool; recommend we schedule priming in a rolling fashion across nodes starting T-2h to avoid token cache storms.

Fallback validation: I've created a small harness to simulate region-fallback and model-variant fallback. Results attached as a log snippet in the Drive link. Main callouts:
- Automated fallback succeeded in 9/10 simulated failures; the single failure was due to an auth token rotation that we've since patched.
- Recommendation: add an automated post-cutover smoke that triggers a 30s simulated failure and asserts successful fallback within 45s.

I'll join the runbook review on 10/12 and can demo the priming commands.

- Karthik
Principal Infra PM | Redwood Inference
